archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-05.3 Perform Consistency and Coherence Checks
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Next, the composed products are tested for internal and cross-domain consistency. This means checking that the values across datasets, tables, or indicators align logically and methodologically. For example, totals should match their components, derived indices should follow expected trends, and time series should show plausible continuity. Any inconsistencies are reviewed and corrected. This ensures that all data and indicators in the statistical product tell a consistent and coherent story.
Value created: Reliable and internally consistent statistical products that maintain user confidence.
